narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.43 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 890.59-917.15 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 932.25; the first objective pays 2.29R at 889.84.

plan.invalidation: structure beyond 932.25 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone
